profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker XPEV, with CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish site presents the brand as selling a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo" and says the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The site lists three models, the G6, G9 and P7⁺, which it says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, allowing a charge from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km. Visitors are invited to leave their details to arrange a test drive or ask for more information.

The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries made through it. It also publishes financing examples, including the G6 RWD Standard Range at a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 € with a T.A.E. of 3,53%, and the G9 RWD Standard Range at a cash price of 56.590,30€ with a T.A.E. of 6,76%. The financing is offered subject to study and approval by Open Bank, S.A.
